meta.name: og-dbr-rev0
meta.notes: Orange Gate DBR Rev 0 baseline design. Twin-bore 11 m tunnel, 4240 m per tube, K 4.1 at 50 bar nozzles, 29.0 lpm per head design target. 25 heads per 30 m zone × 3 simultaneous = 75 active heads, 2175 lpm total flow. Neutral presets with project-specific overrides. This is the golden-deck baseline for the optimisation loop.

constraints.note: Site and procurement limits. NOT from SOLIT2 and not acceptance criteria.
